submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is a local animation anatomy repair. IMAGE 1 is the 15 water-dragon scholar BOY edit target: preserve his exact identity, rendering, head/torso scale, camera and canvas placement. IMAGE 2 is the user-confirmed 09 archer gait-phase reference ONLY, use its hip-knee-ankle motion and ground-bearing mechanics, not its gender, clothing, bow, identity or hand assignment. IMAGE 3 locks the boy identity. IMAGE 4 is the approved painted finishing style. Rear three-quarter NW running toward upper-left. Keep exact image1 head/torso scale and canvas placement. Correct BOTH legs using image2's fore-aft hip-knee-ankle paths, with far RIGHT thigh passing forward underneath pelvis toward screen-left and near LEFT thigh visibly crossing behind toward screen-right; layered thigh overlap must remain traceable under the robe. Do NOT reserve left/right boots to permanent screen-side positions. Right shoe axis NW. RIGHT MID-STANCE with near LEFT knee beginning to pass forward: RIGHT support stays flat at y1170 under/left of torso, LEFT knee now travels from rear toward under pelvis, still bent with boot lifted and sole backward. This is passing, not high lateral knee lift. Also correct near LEFT empty arm transition: shoulder stays attached, elbow gently retreats, empty fist shifts from far front-down to beside LEFT waist/jade, halfway into backswing; sleeve follows elbow. Right fan begins return from low rear but stays RIGHT hand; modest posture intermediate. Only arms/legs/adjacent cloth move; lock head/face/torso size. Do not merely rotate the boots or narrow the stance: correct connected thigh, knee, shin, ankle and boot wherever specified. Do not crop, zoom, resize or globally translate the boy. Keep anatomical RIGHT hand holding the ivory blue-water-dragon fan and anatomical LEFT hand empty; jade pendant on his anatomical LEFT hip. Exactly two arms/two hands/two legs/two boots. Complete single frame native 1254x1254 square RGBA with real transparent background. Keep all anatomy, fan and tassels inside canvas. No archer, bow, green costume, duplicate limbs, floor, ground shadow, effects, text, watermark or collage. Config target GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst max; actual route is host-managed builtin.
